title: INTERVenE: Temporal-Abstraction-Interval Based Transformers for Short-Horizon Medical Event Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.29901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electronic Health Record (EHR) prediction models in the intensive care unit must learn from sparse and irregular measurements while preserving the clinical meaning of time and supporting transparent decision-making. We present INTERVenE, a family of Transformer architectures whose input is an interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstraction (KBTA), a token stream of named clinical concepts (states, trends, events, contexts) drawn from a curated medical ontology, rather than an unnamed bin index or a raw measurement triplet. This naming layer is what we ask KBTA to do: it makes the model's per-token attributions resolve to clinical concepts by construction. INTERVenE offers two complementary variants: an auto-regressive decoder that generates future abstraction trajectories with a per-step risk readout (localizing \emph{when} and \emph{after which events} risk rises), and a bidirectional encoder for single-pass joint risk and time-t

translated_title: INTERVenE：基于时间抽象区间的Transformer用于短期医疗事件预测
translated_abstract: 重症监护室（ICU）中的电子健康记录（EHR）预测模型必须能够从稀疏且不规则的测量数据中学习，同时保留时间的临床意义并支持透明的决策。我们提出了INTERVenE，这是一族Transformer架构，其输入是基于区间的、基于知识的时间抽象（KBTA），即一个由命名的临床概念（状态、趋势、事件、上下文）组成的token流，这些概念取自精心整理的医学本体，而非未命名的分箱索引或原始测量三元组。这一命名层正是我们要求KBTA所实现的功能：它使模型对每个token的归因在构造上就能对应到具体的临床概念。INTERVenE提供两种互补的变体：一种是自回归解码器，可生成未来的抽象轨迹，并在每一步输出风险读数（从而定位风险何时升高以及在哪些事件之后升高）；另一种是双向编码器，用于单次前向传播中联合预测风险与时间……
tldr: INTERVenE提出了一族以区间式知识时间抽象（KBTA）生成的命名临床概念作为token输入的Transformer架构，通过自回归解码器和双向编码器两种变体，在保留时间临床意义的同时实现ICU中可解释的短期医疗事件与风险预测。
en_tdlr: INTERVenE introduces a family of Transformer architectures that consume interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstractions (KBTA) of named clinical concepts as tokens, offering an auto-regressive decoder and a bidirectional encoder for interpretable short-horizon medical event and risk prediction in the ICU.
